observation_summary: The application throws a NullPointerException when attempting to remove a marker from a plot because the code does not verify if the marker collection exists before calling the remove method.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves adding a null check ('if (markers == null) { return false; }') before accessing the 'markers' collection. This is a classic missing guard/validation check, which falls squarely under the 'Checking' category in ODC.
evidence_used: The stack trace shows a NullPointerException at the line 'boolean removed = markers.remove(marker);'.
The fix diff shows the addition of an 'if (markers == null) { return false; }' block before the 'markers.remove(marker)' call in both CategoryPlot and XYPlot classes.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: The issue is not a flaw in the removal algorithm itself, but a failure to validate the state (existence of the collection) before executing the algorithm.
